content: निपातन {%a.%} Killing, destroying. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Throwing down, beating or knocking down; अवगूर्य चरेत् कृच्छ्रमतिकृच्छ्रं निपातने <ls>Ms. 11. 209</ls>. .²2 Overthrowing, destroying, killing; माषकस्तु भवेद्दण्डः श्वसूकरनिपातने <ls>Ms. 8. 298</ls>. .²3 Touching with. .²4 Putting down as irregular or exceptional. .²5 An irregular form of a word, irregularity, exception; यल्लक्षणेनानुत्पन्नं तत् सर्वं निपातनात् सिद्धम् <ls>Mbh.</ls> .²6 Falling or flying down.
